title: Alakazam's One-of-One Spoons Become Deep-Trust Gifts
premise: Alakazam psychically creates unique spoons, then may let someone deeply trusted have one.
audiencePromise: Reveal how Alakazam makes each spoon unique, then show why receiving one means deep trust.
openLoop: Would Alakazam ever give away a spoon no one else has?
payoff: Its spoon becomes a deeply personal gift: one original, shared through trust, for apparently delicious food.
engagementQuestion: Would you treasure it, or use it for delicious meals?

voice.instructions: Quick, warm, and playful. Stress one-of-one and deep trust. Use short pauses before each reveal, then end with a curious either-or question.

scenes.headline: THE SPOON IS UNIQUE
scenes.narration: Alakazam makes one-of-one spoons. Giving one requires trust.
scenes.caption: EVERY SPOON MATTERS

scenes.headline: MADE BY PSYCHIC POWER
scenes.narration: Its spoons are said to be created by psychic powers.
scenes.caption: THE SPOON STARTS WITH A PSYCHIC CREATION

scenes.headline: ONLY ONE EXISTS
scenes.narration: Each spoon is the only original of its kind worldwide.
scenes.caption: NO SECOND ORIGINAL EXISTS

scenes.headline: THE SPOON CAN BE SHARED
scenes.narration: That unique spoon can leave Alakazam's own hands.
scenes.caption: AN ORIGINAL CAN BECOME SOMEONE ELSE'S

scenes.headline: TRUST COMES FIRST
scenes.narration: If it trusts someone deeply, it will let them have one.
scenes.caption: A UNIQUE GIFT FOR DEEP TRUST

scenes.headline: A SPOON WITH MEANING
scenes.narration: Would you treasure it, or use it for delicious meals?
scenes.caption: ONE ORIGINAL. GIVEN THROUGH TRUST.
